title: The Sundering
value: The Sundering broke the old Elder empire. Most of what stood before it is rubble now.

title: The Sundering
value: The Sundering ended the Elder empire eight centuries ago, when the wardstones cracked and the Wood swallowed the cities whole. Survivors scattered into the kingdoms that quarrel today; the Elder roads still run beneath them, and the ruins still hum. Scholars argue whether the Sundering was a weapon, a punishment, or a mistake.

title: Aethel Wood
value: The Aethel Wood is an old forest that grows over the bones of the Elder empire. It moves a little when no one watches.

title: The Long Memory
value: The Long Memory is the elven discipline of inherited recollection: an elf old enough can recall events from before their own birth as if they lived them. Humans find it unsettling; the Elder ruins answer to those who carry it.

title: Wardstones
value: Wardstones are Elder relics that bind the Wood back from the old roads. Most are cracked; a whole one is worth a duchy. Only deep history remembers how they were made.
